officialSummary: When the UN was founded in 1945, computers, the internet and satellites were the stuff of science fiction. Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is already assisting in targeting, drones are reshaping warfare and disinformation is spreading in unprecedented ways, fuelling record levels of conflict. The Security Council on Tuesday is weighing these changes, and how new tools could strengthen early warning, mediation and peacekeeping.
title: Security Council LIVE: Can conflict resolution keep pace as AI and drones reshape war?
